top_posts.author: Ro_Patel
top_posts.text:
$COST declares $30 a share special dividend (double its last paid in Jan 2024) & renews $4B buyback 
 
The payout, worth about $13.3B in total, goes to shareholders of record on Nov 24 & the new buyback runs to Nov 2030 
 
Remaining Auth including new auth: $4.9B 
 
Separately, director Helena B. Foulkes has told the board she will resign effective Nov 7, 2026, after being elected governor
